claims.reason: Overview.tsx derives toolsReady only from authenticated browser plus persisted mcpSetupComplete, while App.tsx currentToolProof explicitly rejects a failed production automatic runtime-start operation; App.tsx does not pass operation to Overview.
The claim searches only styles.css, but main.tsx imports nekodex.css afterward; nekodex.css:373-375 adds wrapped narrow browser-toolbar behavior, so the asserted absence of narrow handling is false.

Overview is styled by the downstream nekodex.css imported after styles.css: rules exist at nekodex.css:172-232 and responsive container rules at 286-322 and 439-444; searching styles.css alone does not establish an unstyled renderer.

The direct Overview caller omits operation, so Overview can show tools verified and ready after the same failed production automatic runtime-start that currentToolProof rejects; optional MCP navigation does not justify stale positive proof.

roots.title: Overview publishes stale tool readiness after failed automatic runtime start
roots.trigger: In production automatic mode, keep authenticated browser, verified catalog and picker, and mcpSetupComplete true; then receive an operation with name runtime-start and status failed.
roots.fix: Make Overview consume the shared currentToolProof(snapshot, operation) result, or pass an equivalent current operation-aware tool-proof value from App.tsx; keep the public connector ABI and names unchanged.
